description: Law explores where laws come from and how the legal system works: legal history, civil and criminal law, public opinion, consumer protection, courts and mock trials, lawyers and judges, legal aid, and the many areas of law and careers in it.

versions.label: Checked against official scouting.org excerpts (partial verification)

provenance.notes: Requirement numbering and topics were checked against excerpts of official Scouting America pages (scouting.org) returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. The pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so wording was not compared word for word and some sub-items may be summarized from partial excerpts. Summaries are ScoutPath's own words.

references.label: Official merit badge page (scouting.org Merit Badge Hub)

requirements.summary: What law is, where it comes from and the purposes it serves.

requirements.title: Legal history
requirements.summary: Options such as ancient law codes and the Magna Carta, the jury system or famous trials.

requirements.summary: The differences between civil and criminal law, with examples.

requirements.title: Public opinion
requirements.summary: Asking several people about the role of law enforcement and reporting back.

requirements.title: Consumer protection
requirements.summary: Laws and organizations that protect consumers and sellers.

requirements.summary: One option: attending a court session and summarizing it, or organizing a mock trial.

requirements.title: Visiting a lawyer
requirements.summary: Meeting a lawyer who works for a business or government agency.
